review.imagery: 33 gallery entries include 13 dated site photographs. All fifteen primary assets, the complete 39-page brochure index, 31 native resources and thirteen September 2026 photographs were visually reviewed. One exact primary facade repeat and two lower-resolution repeated tower views, repeated brochure scenes, mask layers and generic lifestyle material were excluded. Eight brochure scenes add full architecture, pools, lobby and home living. Shared Cove interiors remain developer concepts. The whole street building supplies the card and hero.
review.floorPlans: All three whole physical plan pages 2–4 were visually reviewed, preserving the exact 2–13 floor group and rooftop amenities. Three freely displayed Silver Oak drawings were viewed independently at native size. They show one studio and two 1 BR layouts, without numerical areas. Their file numbers are not contractual unit confirmation. Four further previews remain form-gated and unretrieved. No ground/podium sheets occur in this packet. Three complete building drawings and three attributed broker home previews are available. No numerical individual saleable areas are printed. Image-position labels do not establish contractual unit numbers. Four remaining broker layouts are form-gated and unretrieved. Confirm contractual units, standalone home sheets and final revisions with Imtiaz.
review.location: Whole original brochure map 33 was rendered at 3200 pixels and visually read. Its regional rings supply no individual route schedule. The official named-place embed supplies no explicit target coordinates. Camera-centre values were excluded and named-place directions remain available.
review.provenance: Official project/gallery and September 2026 construction sources retain dated URL and SHA-256 receipts. Original brochures and building drawings retain their actual developer, broker or platform-host attribution. Whole sheets, notices and original source bytes remain intact. Protected researched records remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual contractual areas and home matching, ground/podium drawings, remaining form-gated broker plans, individual destination estimates, exact visitor entrance, current certified site progress and final specifications remain unavailable or unverified.
